007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.AvailableTeam;
013
014import java.util.List;
015
016/**
017 * Discovers teams available to the connected database user.
018 *
019 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}, and
020 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL} before running this sample. The database package
021 * may return teams owned by another schema when access has been granted. The
022 * returned {@link AvailableTeam} values are read-only discovery snapshots;
023 * use an owner-qualified team name with
024 * {@link SelectAIAgent#runTeam(String,
025 * com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RunTeamRequest)} to run a shared
026 * team.</p>
027 */
028public final class ListAvailableTeamsSample {
029
030    private ListAvailableTeamsSample() {
031    }
032
033    /**
034     * Lists and prints teams available to the current database user.
035     *
036     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
037     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
038     */
039    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
040        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
041            List<AvailableTeam> teams = client.listAvailableTeams();
042            System.out.printf("Found %d available team(s).%n", teams.size());
043            for (AvailableTeam team : teams) {
044                System.out.printf("Team: %s; description: %s%n",
045                        team.getTeamName(), team.getDescription());
046                System.out.printf("Raw discovery JSON: %s%n", team.getRawJson());
047            }
048        }
049    }
050
051    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
052        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
053                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
054                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
055                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
056                .build());
057    }
058
059    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
060        String value = System.getenv(name);
061        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
062            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
063        }
064        return value;
065    }
066}
